_meta.discriminator: SS3a fires on GLOBAL, PERVASIVE, PERSISTENT loss of interest/energy/motivation/connection across life (across the board / lately / in general). It must NOT fire on LOCAL, situational, task-specific, or physical look-alikes (this one thing / today / after X). See list B for the precision boundary.
